audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of 30 location strings covering CalicoJack, house and community upgrades, Joja membership, Mines, town signs, profession statue and Dark Shrines. Glossary corporation, building, material, item, profession and place names, placeholders, quantities, currency, newlines and caret-delimited shrine pages were preserved.

records.english: Hey, the betting's fixed at 100 coins. You don't have enough. Go buy some coins from the machine if you want to play.
records.translation: Гей, ставка незмінна — 100 монет. У вас недостатньо. Якщо хочете грати, придбайте монети в автоматі.

records.english: I can increase the size of your house and add a kitchen. It will cost 10,000g and you'll also need to provide me with 450 pieces of wood. Are you interested?
records.translation: Я можу розширити ваш будинок і додати кухню. Це коштуватиме 10 000g, а ще мені знадобиться 450 одиниць деревини. Зацікавились?

records.english: I can increase the size of your house and add a nursery. It will cost {0}g and you'll also need to provide me with {1} pieces of hardwood. Are you interested?

records.english: I can add a cellar to your house. The cellar can be used to age certain products, like wine and cheese. It will cost 100,000g. Are you interested?
records.translation: Я можу додати до вашого будинку льох. У ньому можна витримувати деякі продукти, як-от вино й сир. Це коштуватиме 100 000g. Зацікавились?

records.english: ...What's that? You want to build Pam a house? That's a great idea!^I'll just need 950 wood and 500,000g...

records.english: If you become a Joja Member, the community center will become a Joja Warehouse, and you will no longer be able to refurbish it. However, Joja will provide an alternative means to improving the town. Are you sure you want to join?
records.translation: Якщо ви станете членом Joja, Громадський центр перетвориться на Склад Joja й відновити його вже не вдасться. Натомість Joja запропонує інший спосіб поліпшення містечка. Ви точно хочете приєднатися?
